note_tsim: Date from comparison with other maps by Paul Labrosse - see Add Ms 57,704.11. and Add Ms 57,706.3.
Oriented with north to the bottom of the map, indicated by a decorative compass rose.
Shows "RIVER KATARAKOUI" for the Saint Lawrence River (an error?).
Shows an "Echelle de 16 arpents" at centre left.
The map is annotated with textual notes (in French) describing the terrain.
Signed "PAUL LABROSSE FECIT AT LOWER RIGHT".

Shows an inset view of Fort de la Présentation at upper right titled "Elevations et vué du fort de la Presentation de La Pointe marqué C au fort A" (where A marks the fort on the larger map and C is the point from which the elevation was drawn). The inset has its own scale, "Eschelle de 15 Toises pour L'Elevations seulement"(scale approximately 1:200).

Copy at Add Ms 57,707.4. Bound in R.U.S.I. Vol LXXII. Shows manuscript addition of "4" in pencil at lower right, a small "19" and "4" at upper right, and "A 28/42" at lower left. Laid on archival tissue. Green circular label to verso showing "17". White label to verso showing "DRAWER 28 SECTION 2". Signed in ink to verso "Labrosse".
